title: R’ Chama the Tall
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut, Mishlei, remez 960, according to Otzar Yisrael. Hyman says he has not found him in his Yalkut and that the reading should undoubtedly be R’ Chiyya the Tall.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman’s unsuccessful search and emphatic proposed correction are his own report. The consulted digital Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 960 actually contains the form R’ Chama Arikha; it therefore differs from the edition Hyman describes. The abbreviated titles of Chama and the proposed Chiyya are retained as R’.
